race.title: Get A Free Trial At racingtv.com/freetrial Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: MR MACKAY showed he retains all his ability when runner-up on reappearance, and this looks a good opportunity to go one better. The next-best vote goes to Everyonesgame , who has less to prove than course winner King Jon Oliver . MR MACKAY (IRE) EVERYONESGAME (IRE) KING JON OLIVER (FR)
race.bettingForecast: Mr Mackay (6/4), Everyonesgame (9/4), King Jon Oliver (5/1), At Mangan Bridge (6/1), Greatness Awaits (10/1)
